scenario.policy: Fictional Harbor Airport. Six parties, seven people; all travel is free replacement travel. Respect party sizes and voluntary consent. Never split a party. Compensation pool is 40 credits, maximum 40 per offer. Credits are fictional, not money or legal entitlements. Ask about hidden deadlines, modes and compensation. Only commit_offer confirms a booking; accepted offers hold seats and credits for three logical ticks. Old bookings remain until a replacement is committed. Capacity and credits cannot be invented. Rejected operations have no effect. list_cases returns known facts only. Finish only when appropriate; an unresolved party may still have options. You may contact any party, including an already-booked party, to negotiate a voluntary change. Each decision advances one logical tick. Tools expose actual state except explicitly untrusted observations; booking receipts are authoritative.
